# Lootlore

> Hand-researched game guides, one hub.

- [Beast of Reincarnation](https://lootlore-ten.vercel.app/beast-of-reincarnation/en): Game Freak's first AAA action RPG: a one-person, one-dog souls-like set in Japan, Year 4026. Nushi boss strategies with per-chapter levels and weaknesses, Emma's builds and skill trees, Koo's command system, trophy data and patch tracking — rewritten from the live game after launch.
- [Shift At Midnight](https://lootlore-ten.vercel.app/shift-at-midnight/): The graveyard-shift horror sim where your customers might be doppelgangers. Every monster from Marionette to the Dentist with tells and counters, all 10 achievements with rarity data, every ending, night-by-night survival guides and a straight answer on crossplay.
- [DragonSword: Awakening](https://lootlore-ten.vercel.app/dragonsword-awakening/): An anime-style open-world action RPG set on the Continent of Orbis. How Status Ailment tag-team combat actually works, all 19 Heroes with a tier list, the Cooking and Familiar systems, chapter bosses, gear, runes and Karma — every number from verified sources.
- [Sephiria](https://lootlore-ten.vercel.app/sephiria/): The top-down action roguelite from the studio behind Dungeon Squad. All 6 weapon classes, the Artifact and Tablet inventory system, build routes, every boss chapter and the final boss's endings, plus patch notes tracked through 1.0.30 — with 4-player co-op covered.
- [Sir, We Have an Orc Problem](https://lootlore-ten.vercel.app/orc-problem/): An incremental-style tower defense about holding the line against tens of thousands of orcs. Real turret numbers for every tower, all four abilities, the upgrade grind, level challenges from the 3-2 difficulty spike to damageless runs, and achievements mapped to levels.
